paragraphs.text: We had walked this street a hundred times. That morning, with no
appointment ahead of us, it seemed to contain an entirely different city.
There was a seam of light beneath the bookshop door, a pear tree
leaning over a wall, the sound of someone practising a difficult piece of
music. Nothing had changed. We had simply begun to notice.

roles.text: A walk without a destination can change the shape of a day.

Nothing had changed. We had simply begun to notice.
“Attention is a way of making room.”
